input_mode: same first six physical PDF pages, no answer-based selection
numeric_scoring: Decimal exact value times disclosed unit; no post-hoc tolerance; preserve paired reference variants
evidence_scoring: NFKC and whitespace normalization; quote must occur in stated input page and contain field alias plus stated numeric value
primary_denominator: all nine planned fields in each split; failures and abstentions retained
limitations: Six reports, same three companies across years; not company-held-out generalization or independent field samples.
Period and consolidated scope are requested constraints, so their scores measure consistency rather than independent recognition.
Given front-page PDF text extraction, not OCR, full-document retrieval, financial reasoning or model fine-tuning.
Reference is assistant visual review pending human audit, not expert gold or an inter-annotator agreement study.
Public historical documents may overlap model pretraining; fixed model date does not prove absence of contamination.
